title: Dua for seeking forgiveness which leads to more knowledge & more Fortune
data:
اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ الرَّحْمٰنَ الرَّحِيْمَ بَدِيْعُ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ ظُلْمِيْ وَ جُرْمِيْ وَ اِسْرَافِيْ عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
ASTAGHFIRUL LAAHAL LAZEE LAA ELAAHA ILLAA HOWAL HAYYUL QAYYOOMAR RAHMAANAR RAHEEMA BADEE-O'S SAMAAWAATE WAL ARZE MIN JAMEE-E ZULMEE WA JURMEE WA ISRAAFEE ALAA NAFSEE WA ATOOBO ILAYHE
I seek the forgiveness of Allah, other than Whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, from all my wrongdoing, my transgression, and my excess against my own soul, and I turn to Him in repentance.
merits: Another tradition reported from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) holds that whoever says this imploration for Almighty Allah's forgiveness four hundred times each day for two successive months will be granted much knowledge or much fortune.
